about: Blind grades of every row a criterion or report reads that no earlier grade or label answered: builds entering or leaving a top 5, a top 20 or a matched list, base to c1 or c2, on every changed query (frozen sets, the battery questions captured at 1.9.108, the fresh set). Rubric in grader-prompt.txt. A battery question is named by its id (held out <id>); its text stays in scratch. grade is the stricter of the two passes.
graders: two independent Claude Sonnet agents, each with its own shuffled order of one sheet, no mark of which variant listed a build
agreement: 81 rows from 77 sheet rows: the 4 rows of the battery's sa-02 question appear under both captures' ids (held out sa02-verbatim, held out hm26-sa-02). The passes agree on 80 of 81 rows (76 of 77 sheet rows); the one disagreement, 4Bridge on held out hm26-cc-02 (2 against 1), keeps the stricter 1.
